paragraphs.text: Thairin is a merfolk wizard ally from Zendikar .

Thairin is a merfolk aerialist who has been called "the Conqueror" for his leadership during successful forays into the archipelago of floating islands along the coast of Tazeem . It has been said that not many parties are known to call for an aerialist. Still, aerial expertise can be the best solution when an expedition calls for an exploration of a sky-ruin or passage across a days-wide canyon. He has been known to compare the sky to being another sea teaming with currents, life, and endless possibilities.
